title: Universities around the world cut ties with Israeli academia over Gaza war

title: UK lender offers 98% mortgage to first-time buyers – but bars bank of mum and dad
summary: Newcastle building society aims for those with smaller deposits and no help hoping to get on to housing ladder First-time buyers are being offered the chance to borrow up to 98% of the price of a property – but they cannot get help with their deposit from the bank of mum and dad. Newcastle building society’s First Step mortgage is designed to help those who have been saving to get on the housing ladder. Continue reading...
